blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 49 sold over 5 months against an average of 54.4 listed, about 5.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 13 sold. Condos and townhomes: 22 sold over 5 months against an average of 32.6 listed, about 7.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 8 sold.

items.t: tol.ca · township of langley parks receive federal support
Aldergrove's core is centred on Fraser Highway and 272 Street, in the Township of Langley at the Township's east end.
The Aldergrove Core Area is bounded by Bertrand Creek to the north and east, 29 Avenue to the south and 270 Street to the west.
The Township's own eastern boundary is 276 Street at the City of Abbotsford, and its southern boundary is the United States border, so Aldergrove is the last Township community before Abbotsford.
The core plan describes residential land here as large-lot single-family homes, with some townhouses and apartments including fourplexes on 30 Avenue west of 272 Street.

The named new condo form in the core is The Hart at Alder Grove Town Centre, whose buildings are named for Aldergrove pioneer families, with The Hart the fifth building after Shortreed, Jackman and Vanetta.
Lot size steps up fast outside the core: Township minimums run from 464.5 square metres for R-1B and R-1C urban lots to 8,094 square metres for SR-2 suburban lots, with rural land beyond.
Township-wide zoning, Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH), tax and utility facts are in full in the murrayville note — see the murrayville note.

Aldergrove's own angle is the core plan: the Aldergrove Community Plan and the Aldergrove Core Area Plan govern the community, and the Township's Official Community Plan update includes an Aldergrove component.
Bertrand Creek is a rule, not just a view: it bounds the core to the north and east, and the Township directs applicants to check a property's watercourses in GeoSource before applying.
Much of the land around the core is in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), and the Township directs owners to check a specific property's ALR designation in GeoSource.

blocks.text: Aldergrove: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Township-wide utility, suite-charge and tax-calendar facts are in full in the murrayville note — see the murrayville note.

FreshCo at 27566 Fraser Highway is the grocery store named with its address on a Township page listing Extra Garbage sticker sale locations, which is also how a core buyer finds the Township's extra-bag system.
The outdoor pools at the Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre are canopy-covered and open year-round, unlike a seasonal outdoor pool.
Township-wide tax rates, due dates, penalties and utility charges are in full in the murrayville note — see the murrayville note.
Aldergrove's own cost angle is the separate utility bill: Township utility fees are now billed separately from property taxes, so an Aldergrove buyer receives two statements where there was once one.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT) applies in the Township of Langley, which the Province lists as a designated taxable area.
Route 503 is the spine: TransLink's Aldergrove/Langley – Fraser Hwy Express runs from 272 Street at Fraser Highway to Surrey Central Station via Langley Centre and King George Station.
BC Transit route 21 (Aldergrove Connector) links Aldergrove with Abbotsford from the same 272 Street at Fraser Highway stop, making this a two-system transfer point.
Highway 1 (Trans-Canada Highway) runs through the Township north of Aldergrove, and Fraser Highway is the direct road west to Langley and east to Abbotsford.
Check Agricultural Land Reserve status first on any lot outside the core: much Township land is in the ALR, and the Township directs the check to its GeoSource viewer.
Check watercourses the same way: Bertrand Creek bounds the core, and riparian setbacks can remove part of a creek-side lot from the buildable area.

faq.q: Is there a pool and arena in Aldergrove itself?
faq.a: Yes — at one address. The Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre at 27032 Fraser Highway holds pools, the Otter Co-op Outdoor Experience waterpark, an ice arena, a fitness centre and an indoor walking track; its arena is NHL-size (National Hockey League regulation size) with 500 seats and opened August 18, 2018.

faq.q: Can I get to Surrey Central by transit?
faq.a: Yes, by one express bus, and it takes over an hour. TransLink route 503 runs from 272 Street at Fraser Highway via Langley Centre to Surrey Central Station, and its timetable shows westbound trips of about 84 to 98 minutes; BC Transit route 21 connects the same stop east to Abbotsford, and there is no SkyTrain here.

faq.q: Where is the library and the regional park?
faq.a: Both are in the community. Aldergrove Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library) is at 26770 29 Avenue, and Aldergrove Regional Park (Metro Vancouver) has its main entrance at 27240 8 Avenue, south of the core toward the border.
